en.headline: Bad & Breakfast greasy-spoon cafe to open on Wing Lok Street in Sheung Wan
en.dek: The outlet, a sequel to a Yau Ma Tei bar, will serve full English breakfast sets from HK$58 and cocktails at night starting this week.

zh.headline: 上環永樂街將開英式早餐咖啡店Bad & Breakfast
zh.dek: 油麻地酒吧延續項目本周開業，全日英式早餐套餐由58元起，晚間供應雞尾酒。

en.headline: Bar Association tells High Court tribunal erred in clearing Margaret Ng
en.dek: Senior counsel argued the disciplinary panel overlooked the likelihood that Ng’s 2019 unlawful assembly conviction brought the profession into disrepute.

zh.headline: 大律師公會向高院指紀律審裁組錯判吳霧儀無失當
zh.dek: 資深大律師陳詞指審裁組忽略吳霧儀2019年非法集結定罪可能令專業蒙羞。

en.headline: MTR issues non-compliance notice over Tung Chung West station columns
en.dek: The operator said it issued the notice on Monday after about 30 columns were found substandard and is awaiting a remedial proposal from contractors.

zh.headline: 港鐵向東涌西站承建商發出不合規通知
zh.dek: 港鐵表示周一就約30條欠妥支柱向承建商發出通知，正等候全面報告及補救方案。

en.headline: Legco resumes second reading of Northern Metropolis Development Bill on Wednesday
en.dek: The bills committee finished scrutiny after 12 meetings and about 30 hours, and the bill could complete passage this week if supported.

zh.headline: 立法會周三恢復二讀《北部都會區發展條例草案》
zh.dek: 法案委員會完成約30小時審議，若獲支持，本周內可完成三讀程序。

en.headline: Five sentenced in ICAC probe of 400 million yen investment fraud
en.dek: District Court sentenced three defendants today to between 33 and 54 months; ICAC is seeking three more foreign suspects in the case involving fake Standard Chartered documents.

zh.headline: 廉署揭4億日圓投資詐騙案 五人判囚最高54個月 另通緝三人
zh.dek: 區域法院今日判處三名被告介乎33至54個月監禁；廉署正通緝另外三名外籍涉案人士，案件涉及偽造渣打銀行文件。

en.headline: John Lee meets AFC president and outlines five-year sports strategy
en.dek: The Chief Executive told Shaikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa that Hong Kong would strengthen support for team sports and seek more top international football events with Kai Tak Sports Park.

zh.headline: 李家超會晤亞洲足協會長 介紹五年規劃體育策略
zh.dek: 行政長官向Shaikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa表示，政府將加強隊際運動支援，並期待藉助啟德體育園帶來更多頂級國際足球盛事。

en.headline: TDC expects more than 3,000 at Business of IP Asia Forum
en.dek: The two-day event at the Convention and Exhibition Centre on 19 and 20 November will focus on IP commercialisation and run alongside Entrepreneur Day with over 370 startups.

zh.headline: 貿發局預期亞洲知識產權營商論壇逾3000人參與
zh.dek: 兩日活動將於11月19及20日在灣仔會議展覽中心舉行，聚焦知識產權商業化，並與創業日同步，後者有逾370間初創企業。

en.headline: Ocean Park Tower halts mid-air, stranding about 40 visitors
en.dek: A mechanical fault stopped the observation cabin at about 3.30pm on Monday; one visitor felt unwell and was brought down by firefighters, with no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 海洋公園摩天塔機件故障 約40人一度被困半空
zh.dek: 星期一約下午3時半觀光塔停於半空，一名遊客感到不適由消防人員游繩帶離，暫未有人受傷。

en.headline: Digital Policy Office opens applications for robot community pilot
en.dek: Eligible groups may borrow the humanoid Smart Bot free of charge for public events between 15 December and 28 February; the deadline is noon on 20 November.

zh.headline: 數字辦「機器人走入社區」試驗計劃接受申請
zh.dek: 合資格機構可免費借用人形機器人「友智寶」參與12月15日至2月28日的免費社區活動，截止時間為11月20日正午。

en.headline: EMSD finds 720 Tai Zoom lifts missing door-frame parts
en.dek: Director Pang Kwok-ying said about 90 per cent of the contractor’s installations lacked required components; remedial work on two estates is due mid-month and private buildings within two to three months.

zh.headline: 機電署發現臺日720部升降機未裝門框組件
zh.dek: 潘國英指佔該公司安裝總數約九成；兩個租置屋邨執修要求本月中完成，私樓預計兩至三個月內完成。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 33 points at 24449
en.dek: The index ended at 24,449 after trading between 24,437 and 24,733, edging lower from Friday's close of 24,482.

zh.headline: 恆指收市跌33點報24449
zh.dek: 指數全日高見24733、低見24437，最終收報24449點，較上日收市24482點微跌。

en.headline: Legco to require research for non-binding motions from next year
en.dek: Legislative Council President Starry Lee said lawmakers must submit research findings and recommendations when raising motions without legislative effect, to make debates more evidence-based.

zh.headline: 立法會明年起非立法效力議案須附研究
zh.dek: 立法會主席李慧瓊表示，議員提出無立法效力的議案時須提交研究結果及建議，讓政府及公眾更易理解意圖，促進以證據為本的討論。

en.headline: Police arrest Citybus driver after pedestrian dies in North Point
en.dek: A man was struck by a Citybus at about 8am on King's Road near Tin Chong Street; he was pronounced dead at Eastern Hospital at 8.54am and the driver has been arrested.

zh.headline: 北角城巴撞倒途人致死 司機被捕
zh.dek: 今早約8時，一名男子在北角英皇道近電廠街遭城巴撞倒，送東區醫院後於8時54分證實死亡，城巴司機已被捕。

en.headline: MUJI marks 25 years in Hong Kong with Central exhibition and Ferris-wheel installation
en.dek: The free “Origin. From MUJI” display runs until 29 November on the first floor of Man Yee Building, featuring a large Ferris-wheel structure and brand milestones.

zh.headline: 無印良品香港25周年 中環萬宜大廈展出巨型摩天輪裝置
zh.dek: 「原點．源於 無印良品」主題展覽即日起至11月29日於萬宜大廈商場1樓中庭舉行，設大型摩天輪打卡點，免費入場。

en.headline: Chan says firms accelerating supply-chain diversification amid geopolitical uncertainty
en.dek: The Financial Secretary told the AFRC Regional Regulatory Forum that Hong Kong saw 121 new listings in the first 10 months raising over HK$400 billion, up 40 per cent on all of last year.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：地緣政治不確定下企業加速供應鏈多元化
zh.dek: 財政司司長在會財局區域監管論壇表示，今年首十個月本港有121宗新股上市，集資逾4000億元，較去年全年增四成。

en.headline: Observatory records coolest autumn morning so far at 23.2 degrees
en.dek: The Observatory recorded 23.2C at 7:40am on Monday, the lowest since autumn began, as the cold front and strong monsoon bring further cooling tonight to about 19C urban.

zh.headline: 天文台錄得今年入秋以來最低23.2度 今晚市區約19度
zh.dek: 天文台今早7時40分錄得23.2度，為今年入秋以來最低；冷鋒及強烈季候風影響下，今晚市區最低約19度。

en.headline: Experts say high-strength concrete can fix defective columns at Tung Chung West station
en.dek: Engineering lawmaker Aaron Bok says non-shrink grout can fill gaps in about 30 columns where concrete failed to reach the ceiling, calling the work a basic mistake.

zh.headline: 專家稱高強度混凝土可修復東涌西站欠妥支柱
zh.dek: 工程界議員卜國明指可用無收縮灌漿填充約30條支柱缺口，混凝土未灌至天花屬基本失誤。

en.headline: Frieren anime exhibition to open at Mong Kok INCUBASE Arena on 24 November
en.dek: The official Beyond Journey's End exhibition runs until 3 January at Chong Hing Square basement, with early-bird tickets on sale until 23 November.

zh.headline: 《葬送的芙莉蓮》特展11月24日起於旺角創興廣場舉行
zh.dek: 官方動畫展於創興廣場地庫INCUBASE Arena展出至明年1月3日，早鳥票售至11月23日。

en.headline: Man dies after being struck by Citybus while crossing in North Point
en.dek: A man in his forties was hit by a Citybus at about 8:17am on King's Road near Tin Chong Street; he was pronounced dead at Eastern Hospital at 8:54am.

zh.headline: 北角男途人疑過路遭城巴撞飛 送院後不治
zh.dek: 今早約8時17分，一名約40歲男子在北角英皇道近電廠街橫過馬路時遭城巴撞倒，送東區醫院後於8時54分證實死亡。

en.headline: Woman dies four days after being hit by FEHD contractor truck in North Point
en.dek: The 60-year-old pedestrian, surnamed Ng, was struck on 4 November near the Sunbeam Theatre; the 45-year-old driver has been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death.

zh.headline: 北角食環外判貨車撞倒60歲女途人 留醫四日不治 司機涉危駕致死被捕
zh.dek: 姓吳女子上月4日晚在新光戲院對開被撞，周日中午證實死亡；45歲姓林司機涉危險駕駛引致他人死亡，已保釋候查。

en.headline: Police record nearly 18 per cent rise in ransomware cases as AI aids attacks
en.dek: Technology crime fell overall in the first nine months, but ransomware rose while police used their AI engine in an Interpol operation that took down more than 50,000 malicious sites.

zh.headline: 警方錄得勒索軟件個案近升一成八 人工智能助攻
zh.dek: 首九個月科技罪案整體下跌，惟勒索軟件上升；警方以自主AI引擎聯同國際刑警行動，下架逾5萬個惡意網站。

en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal and Red Fire Danger Warning in force as cold front arrives
en.dek: The Observatory raised both signals at 06:10 HKT; northerly winds exceed 40 km/h with gusts to gale force, and temperatures will fall to about 16C by Tuesday morning.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號及紅色火災危險警告生效 冷鋒抵港
zh.dek: 天文台於清晨6時10分發出兩項警告；偏北強風平均超過每小時40公里，陣風達烈風，周二早上市區最低約16度。

en.headline: Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay with fairy-tale puppets next weekend
en.dek: The free outdoor youth arts festival runs 14-15 November at Victoria Park, featuring illuminated night and grand finale parades with giant puppets.

zh.headline: 渣打藝趣嘉年華下周末重臨銅鑼灣 童話巨型木偶巡遊
zh.dek: 免費戶外青年藝術節於11月14至15日在維園舉行，設夜光及壓軸巡遊，巨型木偶帶領隊伍。

en.headline: Blue Lock anime exhibition runs at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak until 24 November
en.dek: The official animation exhibition’s first overseas stop features life-size displays, a recreated Z-team locker room and a Hong Kong-exclusive pop-up store.

zh.headline: 藍色監獄動畫展於啟德AIRSIDE舉行至11月24日
zh.dek: 官方動畫展海外首站設等身展示、1:1還原Z隊更衣室及香港限定快閃店。

en.headline: Development Bureau proposes expanding Ta Kwu Ling university town to 75 hectares
en.dek: A paper submitted to the North District Council nearly doubles the campus area and reserves about seven hectares for a second Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts campus.

zh.headline: 發展局建議打鼓嶺大學城擴至75公頃 預留演藝學院第二校舍
zh.dek: 提交北區區議會的文件顯示，校園區面積接近倍增，約7公頃預留予香港演藝學院第二校舍。

en.headline: V Mart creative market continues at Victoria Park through November
en.dek: The free cultural and creative arts market runs on weekends and public holidays in Victoria Park until 29 November as part of a check-in campaign with Windsor House.

zh.headline: 維園V Mart文創市集周末及假日繼續 至11月底
zh.dek: 維多利亞公園的免費文化創意市集於11月1日至29日期間的周六、日及公眾假期舉行，屬皇室堡打卡有禮活動一部分。

en.headline: Lawmakers call MTR column defects at Tung Chung West unimaginable
en.dek: About 30 concrete columns at the station under construction failed to reach the ceiling, but officials say temporary supports mean there is no structural risk and the 2029 opening target holds.

zh.headline: 議員稱東涌西站支柱欠妥「難以想像」 屋宇署指暫無結構風險
zh.dek: 興建中的東涌西站約30條混凝土柱未能灌至天花，但屋宇署指樓板臨時支撐仍在，不構成結構危險，2029年通車目標維持。

en.headline: Customs seize 31kg dried shark fins at airport, charge mainland woman
en.dek: A 51-year-old woman from the mainland arriving from Brazil was arrested after officers found about 31 kilograms of suspected controlled dried shark fins in her checked baggage, valued at HK$130,000.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲約31公斤乾魚翅 內地女旅客被控非法進口
zh.dek: 一名51歲內地女旅客從巴西經埃塞俄比亞抵港，海關在其寄艙行李檢獲約31公斤懷疑受管制乾魚翅，市值約13萬元，已交漁護署落案檢控。

en.headline: Wong Tai Sin Faith and Customs Culture Festival runs through next Sunday
en.dek: The fifth edition of the festival at Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple opened today under the theme of inheritance and crossing, with free workshops, talks and guided tours until 15 November.

zh.headline: 第五屆黃大仙信俗文化節今日開幕 至15日舉行
zh.dek: 嗇色園黃大仙祠舉辦第五屆信俗文化節，主題「傳承與穿越：承『仙』啟後」，設講座、工作坊及導賞，免費入場至11月15日。

en.headline: Claire Liu wins Hong Kong Tennis Open for first WTA title
en.dek: American Claire Liu defeated Philippine rising star Alexandra Eala 6-3, 6-0 in the final at Victoria Park on Sunday, claiming her maiden WTA 250 title in one hour and 33 minutes.

zh.headline: 美國劉婧文擊敗伊雅娜 奪香港網球公開賽冠軍
zh.dek: 周日維多利亞公園決賽，美國球手劉婧文以6-3、6-0直落兩盤擊敗菲律賓新星伊雅娜，首奪WTA巡迴賽冠軍，比賽歷時1小時33分。

en.headline: Police investigate HK$520,000 cash theft from To Kwa Wan supermarket
en.dek: Staff at a budget supermarket on Tam Kung Road found the rear gate forced and two safes emptied of about HK$520,000; Kowloon City detectives are following up with no arrests yet.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣友誠超市爆竊 失約52萬元現金 警正跟進
zh.dek: 周日早上超市職員發現後門被撬，兩個夾萬內約52萬元現金被盜；案件交九龍城警區刑偵隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Mother arrested after 10-year-old left alone overnight in Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: Police arrested a 43-year-old woman on suspicion of cruelty to a child after her grandfather found the girl alone at home in Lai Tsui Court; the child was taken to hospital for checks.

zh.headline: 長沙灣麗翠苑10歲女童通宵獨留家中 43歲母親涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 警方周日拘捕一名43歲女子，涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略；其69歲祖父發現孫女獨留麗柏閣單位，女童已送院檢查。

en.headline: Correctional officer injured after inmate assault at Pik Uk Prison
en.dek: A 23-year-old male inmate attacked a staff member outside his cell early on Sunday; the officer suffered facial injuries and both were sent to hospital, with the case referred to police.

zh.headline: 壁屋監獄 23歲男囚情緒失控襲擊懲教人員 雙雙送院
zh.dek: 周日早上約7時，一名因盜竊罪服刑的23歲男囚在囚室外突然情緒失控襲擊懲教人員，職員面部受傷，兩人均送公立醫院，事件轉交警方調查。

en.headline: Police seize 20kg of ketamine from transitional housing unit in Lau Fau Shan
en.dek: Officers raided a unit in Yuen Long and arrested a 31-year-old man; the drugs and packaging tools were valued at about HK$8 million.

zh.headline: 流浮山過渡性房屋單位作毒品倉 警檢800萬氯胺酮拘一男
zh.dek: 警方在元朗流浮山深灣路一個過渡性房屋單位檢獲約20公斤氯胺酮，拘捕31歲本地男子，市值約800萬元。

en.headline: Three injured after paraglider lands on hikers at Ma On Shan campsite
en.dek: A woman and two teenagers were hurt when a paraglider hit them while landing at Ngong Ping campsite around noon on Sunday; a helicopter took them to hospital.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山昂平營地滑翔傘降落撞傷三人 直升機送院
zh.dek: 周日中午一名女子與兩名青少年在馬鞍山昂平營地被降落的滑翔傘撞傷，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他們送往醫院治理。

en.headline: 67-year-old woman dies after aromatherapy fire at Kingswood Villas
en.dek: A woman found unconscious with burns after a flat fire in Tin Shui Wai on Saturday evening died early Sunday morning; police said the blaze was caused by an aromatherapy item igniting nearby objects.

zh.headline: 天水圍嘉湖山莊香薰火警 67歲婦抢救不治
zh.dek: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居一單位周六傍晚疑因香薰燃點雜物起火，67歲女戶主昏迷送院，延至周日凌晨證實不治。

en.headline: Building repairs bureau to hire about 90 staff initially, Ning says
en.dek: Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said the new non-statutory bureau will start operations by year end and begin services in January, with staff phased in through mid-next year.

zh.headline: 樓宇維修支援及服務局初期聘約90人 年底運作
zh.dek: 發展局局長甯漢豪指新局年底前開始運作，明年1月推出服務，人員明年中前陸續就位。

en.headline: Work week turns cooler and dry after Monday cold front
en.dek: The Observatory forecasts a cold front crossing early Monday, with appreciably lower temperatures midweek and mainly fine, very dry conditions before some showers later.

zh.headline: 冷鋒周一抵港 工作周氣溫顯著下降轉乾燥
zh.dek: 天文台預料冷鋒周一初時橫過廣東沿岸，隨後強烈東北季候風令氣溫明顯下降，中期大致晴朗非常乾燥。

en.headline: Intangible Cultural Heritage Mart runs its final day at the Cultural Centre
en.dek: The free three-day event at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza A and B continues until 6pm today under the theme of crafts in connection and tradition in continuation.

zh.headline: 非物質文化遺產市集今日最後一天於文化中心舉行
zh.dek: 尖沙咀香港文化中心露天廣場A及B區的免費三日活動今日中午12時至下午6時繼續，主題為連藝融通、續寫傳統。

en.headline: Observatory issues Yellow Fire Danger Warning as risk rises
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Yellow Fire Danger Warning at 9:45 a.m. on Sunday, saying the fire risk is high and urging the public and hikers to take precautions.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 火險頗高
zh.dek: 香港天文台周日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，呼籲市民及行山人士提高警覺。

en.headline: Firefighters receive upgraded tracking devices after Tai Po fire inquiry
en.dek: The Fire Services Department has issued 2,000 new two-in-one devices costing HK$8.4 million that allow teammates to detect a distress signal within 500 metres.

zh.headline: 大埔火後消防處向約2000名消防員派發升級定位裝置
zh.dek: 消防處耗資840萬元購置新式二合一裝置，讓隊友可在500米範圍內偵測求救訊號，無需額外手提接收器。

en.headline: Sham Shui Po Diwali Carnival returns to Cheung Sha Wan waterfront today
en.dek: The free community event at Townplace Pier runs from 3pm to 10pm with lantern displays, wishing water lamps, henna art and stage performances.

zh.headline: 深水埗排燈節嘉年華今日重返長沙灣海濱
zh.dek: 本舍碼頭免費社區活動下午3時至晚上10時舉行，設燈籠展示、許願水燈、海娜手繪及舞台表演。

en.headline: Blue Lock Egoist exhibition continues at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak
en.dek: The first overseas stop of the official anime exhibition runs daily until 24 November at the Kai Tak venue, with life-size displays and original artwork.

zh.headline: 藍色監獄Egoist展繼續於啟德AIRSIDE舉行
zh.dek: 官方動畫展海外首站即日起至11月24日於啟德場地每日開放，設有等身展示及原畫。

en.headline: Sa Sa Ladies' Purse Day returns to Sha Tin Racecourse today
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club stages the annual raceday at Sha Tin on Sunday, with the feature Ladies' Purse over 1,800 metres and fashion and performance events in the Parade Ring.

zh.headline: 莎莎婦女銀袋日今日重返沙田馬場
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會周日在沙田舉行年度賽馬日，焦點為一千八百米婦女銀袋賽，亮相圈設時裝及表演活動。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts cooler weather from Monday as cold front and northeast monsoon…
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a cold front will cross the South China coast early Monday, followed by an intense northeast monsoon that will bring appreciably lower temperatures, with urban minima around 18 degrees…

zh.headline: 天文台料下周一冷鋒及強烈東北季候風抵港 氣溫顯著下降
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，一道冷鋒將於下周一初時橫過華南沿岸，隨後強烈東北季候風令氣溫明顯下降，下周二市區最低氣溫約18度。

en.headline: M+ opens designated exhibitions free today for fifth anniversary
en.dek: The museum at West Kowloon offers free admission to most galleries from 10am to 8pm on Sunday, excluding two special exhibitions, as part of its anniversary celebrations.

zh.headline: M+五周年今日指定展覽免費開放
zh.dek: 西九文化區M+今日（8日）上午10時至晚上8時免費開放指定展覽，特別展覽除外，最後入場時間為晚上7時。

en.headline: Man in intensive care after football strikes chest at Shau Kei Wan playground
en.dek: A 27-year-old man collapsed during a game at around 5pm on Saturday after the ball hit his chest; bystanders used an AED and performed CPR before he was taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 筱箕灣男子踢波疑被球擊中胸口昏迷 留醫深切治療部
zh.dek: 一名27歲男子周六下午約5時在配水庫遊樂場踢球時疑被足球擊中胸口後失去知覺，在場人士以AED及心肺復甦法急救後送院。

en.headline: Customs seize five suspected endangered turtles in US package at airport
en.dek: Officers found the live turtles, valued at about HK$50,000, inside a parcel from the United States declared as toy model gift boxes; the case has been referred to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲5隻懷疑瀕危活龜 藏美國進口玩具模型包裹
zh.dek: 關員在一個報稱載有玩具模型禮盒的美國進口包裹中發現活龜，估計市值約5萬元，案件已轉交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: Police arrest mainland driver in cross-border unlicensed taxi sting
en.dek: Island District officers posed as passengers for a Wong Chuk Hang to Guangzhou service priced at 1,500 yuan and detained a 42-year-old two-way permit holder on three charges.

zh.headline: 警放蛇打擊跨境白牌車 拘42歲雙程證內地司機
zh.dek: 港島總區交通部警員喬裝乘客，預約由黃竹坑前往廣州的服務，中介開價人民幣1500元，成功拘捕一名42歲持雙程證男子，涉三項罪名。

en.headline: Firefighters extinguish battery fire in Tuen Mun truck under bridge
en.dek: A medium goods vehicle carrying batteries caught fire on Chun Wan Road beneath the Qing Tian Road flyover at about 6:13pm; the blaze was out by 6:36pm with no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 屯門貨車貨斗電池起火 消防撲熄無人受傷
zh.dek: 一輛中型貨車傍晚約6時13分在震寰路青田路橋底往建生方向行駛時，貨斗內電池突然起火，消防於6時36分將火救熄，無人受傷。

en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal for easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Strong Monsoon Signal at 20:00, warning of mean winds exceeding 40 km/h from the east with occasional gale-force gusts.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 東風強風間中烈風
zh.dek: 香港天文台晚上8時發出強烈季候風信號，預料本港吹東風，平均風速超過每小時40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。

en.headline: Woman found unconscious after unit fire in Tin Shui Wai estate
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at Kingswood Villas Locwood Court Block 14 after a 5:39pm report; a woman was found unconscious in a stairwell and taken to hospital, with about 100 people evacuated.

zh.headline: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居單位起火 女子昏迷送院
zh.dek: 警方下午約5時39分接報嘉湖山莊樂湖居14座單位冒煙，消防約6時07分將火救熄；搜救期間發現一名女子在梯間昏迷，送天水圍醫院治理，約100人自行疏散。

en.headline: Paediatric expert warns colder weather may prolong flu season for children
en.dek: Dr Mike Kwan said the current flu wave could merge with the winter season as temperatures drop next week, and urged parents to vaccinate children soon.

zh.headline: 兒科專家警告天氣轉涼或延長流感季 籲家長儘快為子女接種
zh.dek: 關日華指下周氣溫下降，今季流感或與冬季流感合併，本港已錄得29宗兒童流感嚴重個案，其中兩人死亡。

en.headline: MTR orders halt to unauthorised column repairs at Tung Chung West station
en.dek: Routine October inspections found unapproved filling works on platform-level columns; the operator says the issue does not affect structural safety and has ordered a full review.

zh.headline: 港鐵東涌西站支柱未批修補工序叫停 強調不涉結構安全
zh.dek: 十月恒常巡查發現月台層部分支柱頂部有未經批准的物料填補工序，港鐵已指示總承建商停工並提交報告。

en.headline: Woman dies after fall from Tsing Yi residential building
en.dek: Police and firefighters responded to a report at about 8:28am at Qing Ya Yuan; the woman, believed to be in her late forties, was confirmed dead at the scene.

zh.headline: 青衣青雅苑女子墮樓當場不治
zh.dek: 警方早上約8時28分接報，青雅苑有女子從高處墮下，救護員到場證實當場死亡，年齡約48至50歲。

en.headline: Police arrest three in craft beer machine investment scam involving over HK$4 million
en.dek: Commercial Crime Bureau officers detained a director, office manager and recruiter after six mostly elderly victims reported losses from a scheme promising 60 per cent annual returns.

zh.headline: 手工啤酒機投資騙案警拘3人 至少6名長者涉款逾400萬
zh.dek: 商罪科昨日行動拘捕公司董事、辦事處負責人及招攬者，初步接觸6名多為長者的受害人，合共投資超過400萬元。

en.headline: HKUST president Nancy Ip receives UNESCO life sciences research prize
en.dek: The neuroscientist was honoured in Paris yesterday for work on Alzheimer’s biomarkers and blood tests that enable earlier diagnosis, becoming the sixth Chinese recipient of the award.

zh.headline: 科大校長葉玉如獲教科文組織生命科學研究獎
zh.dek: 頒獎儀式昨日在巴黎舉行，表揚她在阿爾茨海默症生物標記及早期血液檢測方面的貢獻，成為第六位獲獎的中國科學家。

en.headline: John Lee urges youth to stay curious at third development summit
en.dek: More than 3,300 people registered for the flagship forum at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, where the Chief Executive said the first five-year plan would expand opportunities.

zh.headline: 青年發展高峰論壇開幕 李家超籲青年保持好奇心勇於開拓
zh.dek: 第三屆論壇在灣仔會展舉行，逾3300人登記參加，行政長官以視像致辭指首個五年規劃將提升青年機遇。

en.headline: Police identify 60-year-old driver in Central BMW illegal left turn
en.dek: Island District traffic investigators have located the local male driver of a dual-plate BMW filmed reversing near Pedder Street after an illegal turn on 23 October.

zh.headline: 中環寶馬違例左轉 警鎖定60歲本地男司機
zh.dek: 港島總區交通調查組已鎖定10月23日在畢打街違例左轉後倒車的兩地牌寶馬本地男司機，案件列作不小心駕駛跟進。

en.headline: Government strongly rejects joint statement by 10 countries on Wong case
en.dek: The HKSAR Government said the statement by the US, UK, France and seven other nations distorted facts and interfered in judicial independence regarding Joshua Wong's sentencing.

zh.headline: 特區政府嚴正反駁十國就黃之鋒案聯合聲明
zh.dek: 特區政府指美、英、法及另外七國的聲明刻意歪曲事實及干預司法獨立，強烈不滿並堅決反對。

en.headline: Fire at Prince Edward's Kam Wah Cafe injures kitchen worker
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at the 50-year-old cha chaan teng on Bute Street in about 27 minutes; a worker burned his hand fighting the flames before the cafe opened.

zh.headline: 太子弼街金華冰廳早上起火 廚工撲救灼傷手部
zh.dek: 消防早上約6時54分接報，約27分鐘將火救熄；五名職員疏散，一名廚工試圖滅火時手部被油煙灼傷，現場敷治後無大礙。

en.headline: No. 3 alarm fire at Yuen Long paper offerings warehouse leaves 12 evacuated
en.dek: Firefighters brought a blaze at a Pak Sha Tsuen warehouse under control early Saturday after it was upgraded to No. 3 alarm; no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 元朗白沙村紙紮倉庫三級火 12人自行疏散無人受傷
zh.dek: 消防處指周五晚上白沙村一間存放紙紮品的倉庫起火，凌晨升級至三級火警後於今早受控，無人受傷。

en.headline: Cornershop Busking Festival returns to Tsim Sha Tsui with free local music
en.dek: The free Saturday series at The Cornershop on Hart Avenue opens today with an afternoon gathering followed by two evening sets of Hong Kong artists.

zh.headline: Cornershop街頭音樂節重返尖沙咀 本周六起免費本地演出
zh.dek: 赫德道The Cornershop一連四個星期六舉辦免費現場音樂，今日下午先有開幕活動，晚上兩節由本地音樂人演出。

en.headline: HK Phil opens new music director era with Mahler Symphony No. 8
en.dek: Tarmo Peltokoski conducts the orchestra’s first performance of the Symphony of a Thousand at the Cultural Centre this weekend, with multiple choirs and soloists.

zh.headline: 港樂新音樂總監以馬勒第八交響曲揭幕
zh.dek: 貝托祺本周末於文化中心指揮樂團首演《千人交響曲》，聯同多支合唱團及聲樂家演出。

en.headline: Repulse Bay Motoring Classics brings rare cars to south side today
en.dek: The Peninsula-inspired garden party at The Repulse Bay Arcade runs from 2pm to 6:30pm, with classic icons and regional debuts on show.

zh.headline: 影灣園名車盛會今午淺水灣舉行 展出經典名車
zh.dek: 半島酒店集團風格的花園派對於影灣園購物商場下午2時至6時30分舉行，展出經典名車及地區首發車款。

en.headline: Around the Island Race sets sail Saturday with 1,500 sailors
en.dek: The Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club event sends fleets on a 45-kilometre circumnavigation of Hong Kong Island in pursuit format.

zh.headline: 環島帆船賽周六開賽 約1500名水手參與
zh.dek: 皇家香港遊艇會主辦的賽事以追逐形式，讓各組別完成約45公里環繞香港島航程。

en.headline: World Triathlon Cup returns to Central waterfront this weekend
en.dek: Elite women race at 8:45am and men at 10:30am on Saturday over a sprint course along Lung Wo Road, with a mixed relay on Sunday.

zh.headline: 世界三項鐵人盃本周末重返中環海濱
zh.dek: 周六精英女子賽上午8時日分、男子賽上午10時30分於龍和道短程賽道展開，周日有混合接力。
